description.en: Locate a heading by semantic role and prove its exact visible content.
description.id: Temukan heading berdasarkan semantic role lalu buktikan exact visible content-nya.

instructions.en:
# Read a Role Locator

A locator describes how the test recognizes its target when an action or assertion runs. In this controlled page, the level-one heading is meaningful semantic structure.

This is a role-locator warm-up, not a rule that role is always the answer. The chosen page signal must still match the test intent.

## Your task
1. Locate the level-one heading with `getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
2. Use a web assertion to prove its exact text is `Welcome to Playwright`.
instructions.id:
# Baca Role Locator

Locator menjelaskan cara test mengenali target saat action atau assertion dijalankan. Di controlled page ini, level-one heading adalah semantic structure yang bermakna.

Ini latihan awal role locator, bukan rule bahwa role selalu menjadi jawaban. Page signal yang dipilih tetap harus sesuai dengan intent test.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan level-one heading dengan `getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
2. Gunakan web assertion untuk membuktikan exact text-nya adalah `Welcome to Playwright`.

en: The target is semantic document structure: a level-one heading.
Create the locator with `page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
Pass that locator to `expect(...).toHaveText(...)` with the exact expected content.
id: Target-nya adalah semantic document structure: level-one heading.
Buat locator dengan `page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
Kirim locator itu ke `expect(...).toHaveText(...)` dengan exact expected content.

title.en: Choose a Role and Accessible Name

description.en: Identify one user-facing control by role and accessible name, then prove the action outcome.
description.id: Kenali satu user-facing control berdasarkan role dan accessible name, lalu buktikan outcome action-nya.

instructions.en:
# Choose a Role and Accessible Name

## Scenario
A visitor activates the `Sign Up` button. The page should then expose the status `Signed up!`.

`getByRole` reflects the control's semantic role. The accessible name distinguishes it from other buttons. A successful click is not the final evidence, so the scenario also needs a status assertion.

## Your task
1. Locate the button with role `button` and accessible name `Sign Up`.
2. Click that control.
3. Locate the status by role and assert its exact text is `Signed up!`.
instructions.id:
# Pilih Role dan Accessible Name

## Skenario
Visitor mengaktifkan button `Sign Up`. Setelah itu, halaman harus menampilkan status `Signed up!`.

`getByRole` menyatakan semantic role control. Accessible name membedakannya dari button lain. Click yang berhasil bukan final evidence, jadi skenario tetap membutuhkan status assertion.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan control dengan role `button` dan accessible name `Sign Up`.
2. Klik control tersebut.
3. Temukan status berdasarkan role lalu assert exact text-nya adalah `Signed up!`.

en: The action target is a button that users recognize as `Sign Up`.
Use `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' })` for the action.
After the click, use the status role and a text assertion to prove the result.
id: Action target-nya adalah button yang dikenali pengguna sebagai `Sign Up`.
Gunakan `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' })` untuk action.
Setelah click, gunakan status role dan text assertion untuk membuktikan hasilnya.

challenges.htmlContent: Join Us
challenges.solution:
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' }).click();
await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('Signed up!');

description.en: Locate non-interactive content by exact user-visible text and assert that it is visible.
description.id: Temukan non-interactive content berdasarkan exact user-visible text lalu assert bahwa content terlihat.

instructions.en:
# Assert Visible Result Text

## Scenario
The controlled page already shows the result of a completed order. The displayed words `Order complete` are the evidence to inspect.

Use `getByText` for user-visible, non-interactive content when the wording is part of the contract. For a button or link, prefer its role and accessible name. A string match is a substring by default, so use `exact: true` when a longer message should not count.

## Your task
1. Locate the exact visible text `Order complete` with `getByText`.
2. Assert that the matching content is visible.
instructions.id:
# Assert Teks Hasil yang Terlihat

## Skenario
Controlled page sudah menampilkan hasil order yang selesai. Wording `Order complete` adalah bukti yang perlu diperiksa.

Gunakan `getByText` untuk user-visible, non-interactive content saat wording menjadi bagian kontrak. Untuk button atau link, utamakan role dan accessible name. String match memakai substring secara default, jadi gunakan `exact: true` kalau pesan yang lebih panjang nggak boleh ikut cocok.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan exact visible text `Order complete` dengan `getByText`.
2. Assert bahwa content tersebut terlihat.

en: The target is result content, not an interactive control.
Use `page.getByText('Order complete', { exact: true })`.
Pass the locator to `expect(...).toBeVisible()`.
id: Target-nya adalah result content, bukan interactive control.
Gunakan `page.getByText('Order complete', { exact: true })`.
Kirim locator ke `expect(...).toBeVisible()`.

challenges.htmlContent:
Order complete

Confirmation number: ORD-104
challenges.solution: await expect(page.getByText('Order complete', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

title.en: Locate Fields by Their Label Contract

description.en: Fill form controls through their associated labels and verify the entered value.
description.id: Isi form control lewat associated label lalu verifikasi value yang dimasukkan.

instructions.en:
# Locate Fields by Their Label Contract

A labelled field can be located through the relationship between the visible label and its control. This should survive a generated ID change while still exposing a broken label association.

## Your task
1. Fill the field labelled `Username` with `testuser`.
2. Fill the field labelled `Password` with any non-empty practice value.
3. Assert the Username field has value `testuser` with `toHaveValue`.

This exercise uses controlled data. Do not put real credentials in challenge code or reports.
instructions.id:
# Temukan Field dari Kontrak Label

Labelled field bisa ditemukan lewat relationship antara visible label dan control-nya. Kontrak ini seharusnya bertahan saat generated ID berubah, tapi tetap menunjukkan label association yang rusak.

## Tugas kamu
1. Isi field berlabel `Username` dengan `testuser`.
2. Isi field berlabel `Password` dengan practice value apa pun yang tidak kosong.
3. Assert Username field memiliki value `testuser` dengan `toHaveValue`.

Latihan ini memakai controlled data. Jangan memasukkan credential sungguhan ke challenge code atau report.

en: Use the associated visible label rather than the generated input ID.
Call `getByLabel(...).fill(...)` for both controlled fields.
Use `toHaveValue('testuser')` on the Username locator for the evidence.
id: Gunakan associated visible label, bukan generated input ID.
Panggil `getByLabel(...).fill(...)` untuk kedua controlled field.
Gunakan `toHaveValue('testuser')` pada Username locator sebagai buktinya.

description.en: Practice locating a legacy search field by placeholder without treating placeholder as a label.
description.id: Latih pencarian legacy search field berdasarkan placeholder tanpa menganggap placeholder sebagai label.

instructions.en:
# Use a Placeholder Fallback

## Scenario
This controlled legacy search field exposes only the placeholder `Search...`. The placeholder is enough for this optional locator drill, but it does not replace a proper accessible label.

In a product review, report the missing label or request a testability improvement rather than assuming a passing placeholder locator solves accessibility.

## Your task
1. Locate the input by placeholder `Search...`.
2. Fill it with `Playwright testing`.
3. Assert the field has that exact value.
instructions.id:
# Gunakan Placeholder sebagai Fallback

## Skenario
Controlled legacy search field ini hanya menyediakan placeholder `Search...`. Placeholder cukup untuk optional locator drill ini, tapi bukan pengganti proper accessible label.

Saat mereview produk, laporkan label yang hilang atau minta testability improvement. Placeholder locator yang pass nggak otomatis menyelesaikan accessibility.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan input berdasarkan placeholder `Search...`.
2. Isi dengan `Playwright testing`.
3. Assert field memiliki exact value tersebut.

en: The available legacy contract is the placeholder text inside the empty field.
Use `getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing')`.
Use `toHaveValue` for the entered-value evidence.
id: Legacy contract yang tersedia adalah placeholder text di dalam field kosong.
Gunakan `getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing')`.
Gunakan `toHaveValue` sebagai bukti value yang dimasukkan.

challenges.solution:
await page.getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing');
await expect(page.getByPlaceholder('Search...')).toHaveValue('Playwright testing');

title.en: Use an Explicit Test ID Contract
title.id: Gunakan Test ID Contract yang Eksplisit

description.en: Use a developer-owned test ID for a technical counter while keeping the user action semantic.
description.id: Gunakan test ID milik developer untuk technical counter sambil menjaga user action tetap semantic.

instructions.en:
# Use an Explicit Test ID Contract

## Scenario
A customer activates `Add to Cart`. The technical cart counter has the supported test ID `cart-count` and should change from `0` to `1`.

A test ID is an engineering agreement, not proof of user-facing semantics. Use the button's role and accessible name for the action, then the agreed test ID for the counter that lacks a useful visible identity.

## Your task
1. Click `Add to Cart` by role and accessible name.
2. Locate the counter with `getByTestId('cart-count')`.
3. Assert its text becomes `1`.
instructions.id:
# Gunakan Test ID Contract yang Eksplisit

## Skenario
Customer mengaktifkan `Add to Cart`. Technical cart counter memiliki supported test ID `cart-count` dan harus berubah dari `0` menjadi `1`.

Test ID adalah engineering agreement, bukan bukti user-facing semantics. Gunakan role dan accessible name button untuk action, lalu agreed test ID untuk counter yang nggak punya visible identity yang berguna.

## Tugas kamu
1. Klik `Add to Cart` berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
2. Temukan counter dengan `getByTestId('cart-count')`.
3. Assert text-nya berubah menjadi `1`.

en: Keep the customer action user-facing: locate the Add to Cart button by role and name.
The counter's explicit engineering contract is `cart-count`.
Use `toHaveText('1')` on the test-ID locator for the result.
id: Jaga customer action tetap user-facing: temukan Add to Cart button berdasarkan role dan name.
Explicit engineering contract milik counter adalah `cart-count`.
Gunakan `toHaveText('1')` pada test-ID locator sebagai hasil.

challenges.htmlContent:
Widget Pro

0
challenges.solution:
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to Cart' }).click();
await expect(page.getByTestId('cart-count')).toHaveText('1');

title.id: Susun Locator dari List ke Item

description.en: Narrow a semantic list to the one item identified by visible content.
description.id: Persempit semantic list ke satu item yang dikenali dari visible content.

instructions.en:
# Compose from List to Item

A composed locator starts with meaningful scope, then searches inside that scope. This controlled page has one menu list, and the item `Products` is the intended visible contract.

## Your task
1. Locate the list by role.
2. Within that list, locate its list items.
3. Filter for the item containing `Products`.
4. Assert the selected item has exact text `Products`.

Position is not the contract here, so do not choose the second item merely because it is currently second.
instructions.id:
# Susun Locator dari List ke Item

Composed locator dimulai dari meaningful scope, lalu mencari di dalam scope tersebut. Controlled page ini punya satu menu list, dan item `Products` menjadi intended visible contract.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan list berdasarkan role.
2. Di dalam list tersebut, cari list item-nya.
3. Filter item yang berisi `Products`.
4. Assert selected item memiliki exact text `Products`.

Posisi bukan kontraknya, jadi jangan memilih item kedua hanya karena saat ini kebetulan berada di urutan kedua.

en: Start with the semantic list so later matching stays inside that scope.
Chain `getByRole('listitem')` from the list and use `filter({ hasText: 'Products' })`.
Use an exact text assertion on the narrowed item.
id: Mulai dari semantic list supaya pencarian berikutnya tetap berada di scope tersebut.
Chain `getByRole('listitem')` dari list lalu gunakan `filter({ hasText: 'Products' })`.
Gunakan exact text assertion pada narrowed item.

description.en: Work with iframes using frameLocator.
description.id: Bekerja dengan iframe menggunakan frameLocator.

instructions.en:
# Frame Locators

## Concept
Access iframe content with `frameLocator()`. If content is inside an `<iframe>`, normal locators won't find it! You must first locate the frame, then find elements inside it.

## Code Example
```javascript
const frame = page.frameLocator('#my-iframe');
await frame.locator('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
If you try to find a credit card input field inside a Stripe payment element without entering the iframe first, Playwright will fail. `frameLocator` is the key to unlocking these embedded sandboxes.

## Your Task
1. Access the iframe (`#widget`).
2. Click the button inside.
3. Assert the result text is `'Button clicked!'`.
instructions.id:
# Locator Frame

## Concept
Akses konten iframe dengan `frameLocator()`. Jika konten berada di dalam `<iframe>`, locator normal tidak akan menemukannya! Anda harus terlebih dahulu menemukan frame tersebut, lalu menemukan elemen di dalamnya.

## Code Example
```javascript
const frame = page.frameLocator('#my-iframe');
await frame.locator('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Jika Anda mencoba menemukan kolom input kartu kredit di dalam elemen pembayaran Stripe tanpa memasuki iframe terlebih dahulu, Playwright akan gagal. `frameLocator` adalah kunci untuk membuka sandbox yang tertanam ini.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Akses iframe (`#widget`).
2. Klik tombol di dalamnya.
3. Verifikasi teks hasilnya adalah `'Button clicked!'`.

en: When dealing with content in an iframe, you must first switch your focus to that specific internal frame.
Use 'frameLocator()' to get a handle on the iframe, then you can find elements inside it normally.
Define 'const frame = page.frameLocator('#widget');' then call frame.locator('button').click().
id: Saat berurusan dengan konten dalam iframe, Kamu harus terlebih dahulu mengalihkan fokus ke frame internal spesifik tersebut.
Gunakan 'frameLocator()' untuk mendapatkan handle pada iframe, lalu Kamu dapat menemukan elemen di dalamnya secara normal.
Definisikan 'const frame = page.frameLocator('#widget');' lalu panggil frame.locator('button').click().

description.en: Use a retried web assertion when the list size itself is the product contract.
description.id: Gunakan retried web assertion saat list size memang menjadi product contract.

instructions.en:
# Assert a Locator Collection

A locator may intentionally describe several elements when the collection itself is under test. Here, the controlled todo list should contain exactly five list items.

Use `toHaveCount` so Playwright retries the web assertion. Immediate snapshots such as `allTextContents()` are useful for inspection, but they are not the preferred way to assert a dynamically rendered list.

## Your task
Assert that `page.getByRole('listitem')` contains exactly `5` matching items.
instructions.id:
# Assert Locator Collection

Locator boleh sengaja menjelaskan beberapa elemen saat collection memang sedang diuji. Di sini, controlled todo list harus berisi tepat lima list item.

Gunakan `toHaveCount` supaya Playwright melakukan retry pada web assertion. Immediate snapshot seperti `allTextContents()` berguna untuk inspection, tapi bukan pilihan utama untuk meng-assert dynamically rendered list.

## Tugas kamu
Assert bahwa `page.getByRole('listitem')` berisi tepat `5` matching item.

en: The listitem locator is intentionally plural in this exercise.
Pass `page.getByRole('listitem')` directly to `expect`.
Use `toHaveCount(5)` for the retried collection assertion.
id: Listitem locator memang sengaja plural di latihan ini.
Kirim `page.getByRole('listitem')` langsung ke `expect`.
Gunakan `toHaveCount(5)` untuk retried collection assertion.

title.en: Scenario: Add the Exact In-Stock Product
title.id: Skenario: Tambahkan Exact Product yang In Stock

description.en: Narrow repeated product cards by exact identity and state before acting on one intended control.
description.id: Persempit repeated product card berdasarkan exact identity dan state sebelum melakukan action pada satu intended control.

instructions.en:
# Scenario: Add the Exact In-Stock Product

## Scenario
The grid contains `Widget Basic`, `Widget Pro`, and `Widget Pro Max`. Buttons repeat across cards. The test must add the exact `Widget Pro` card only when it shows `In Stock`, then prove the resulting status.

Use semantic descendants to express identity and state. A substring-only `hasText: 'Widget Pro'` can also match `Widget Pro Max`, and `first()` would hide ambiguity.

## Your task
1. Locate the product-card collection by role `article`.
2. Filter to the card containing a heading with exact accessible name `Widget Pro`.
3. Filter that card to one containing exact visible text `In Stock`.
4. Assert the narrowed card count is `1`.
5. Inside it, click `Add to Cart` by role and accessible name.
6. Assert the status has exact text `Added Widget Pro!`.
instructions.id:
# Skenario: Tambahkan Exact Product yang In Stock

## Skenario
Grid berisi `Widget Basic`, `Widget Pro`, dan `Widget Pro Max`. Button berulang di setiap card. Test harus menambahkan exact `Widget Pro` hanya saat card menunjukkan `In Stock`, lalu membuktikan resulting status.

Gunakan semantic descendant untuk menyatakan identity dan state. Substring-only `hasText: 'Widget Pro'` juga bisa cocok dengan `Widget Pro Max`, sedangkan `first()` hanya menyembunyikan ambiguitas.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan product-card collection berdasarkan role `article`.
2. Filter card yang memiliki heading dengan exact accessible name `Widget Pro`.
3. Filter card tersebut ke yang memiliki exact visible text `In Stock`.
4. Assert narrowed card count adalah `1`.
5. Di dalamnya, klik `Add to Cart` berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
6. Assert status memiliki exact text `Added Widget Pro!`.

en: Use `filter({ has: ... })` with an exact heading locator for the product identity.
Add a second `has` filter with exact `In Stock` text, then prove one card remains.
Locate Add to Cart inside that card and assert the status after the click.
id: Gunakan `filter({ has: ... })` dengan exact heading locator untuk product identity.
Tambahkan `has` filter kedua dengan exact text `In Stock`, lalu buktikan hanya satu card tersisa.
Cari Add to Cart di dalam card tersebut dan assert status setelah click.

description.en: Trigger a modal and prove its user-visible dialog becomes available.
description.id: Trigger sebuah modal lalu buktikan user-visible dialog-nya muncul.

instructions.en:
# Prove a Modal Appeared

This standalone page hides a dialog named **Shipping details** until the user activates **Show shipping details**. A successful click is not proof that the modal appeared, so assert the user-visible dialog with `toBeVisible()`.

## Your Task
1. Click **Show shipping details** by button role and accessible name.
2. Locate the **Shipping details** dialog by role and accessible name.
3. Prove the dialog becomes visible.
instructions.id:
# Buktikan Modal Muncul

Standalone page ini menyembunyikan dialog bernama **Shipping details** sampai user mengaktifkan **Show shipping details**. Click yang berhasil belum membuktikan modal muncul, jadi assert user-visible dialog dengan `toBeVisible()`.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Click **Show shipping details** berdasarkan button role dan accessible name.
2. Cari dialog **Shipping details** berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
3. Buktikan dialog menjadi visible.

en: Use the button's accessible name for the trigger.
The result is a dialog named `Shipping details`.
Use `await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()` after the click.
id: Gunakan accessible name milik button sebagai trigger.
Result-nya adalah dialog bernama `Shipping details`.
Gunakan `await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()` setelah click.

challenges.htmlContent: Courier delivery takes 2–3 business days.

await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show shipping details' }).click();
await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Shipping details' })).toBeVisible();

description.en: Use exact and partial text matching according to the product message contract.
description.id: Gunakan exact dan partial text matching sesuai product message contract.

instructions.en:
# Verify Exact and Stable Text

This page confirms an order with a fixed heading and a status containing a generated order number. Use exact text for the heading because the complete message is the contract. Use partial text for the stable phrase inside the dynamic status.

## Your Task
1. Prove the heading has the exact text `Order confirmed`.
2. Prove the status contains `ready for pickup` without hard-coding its order number.
3. Use role-based locators for both pieces of evidence.
instructions.id:
# Verifikasi Exact dan Stable Text

Page ini mengonfirmasi order dengan fixed heading dan status yang berisi generated order number. Gunakan exact text untuk heading karena complete message adalah kontraknya. Gunakan partial text untuk stable phrase di dalam dynamic status.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Buktikan heading punya exact text `Order confirmed`.
2. Buktikan status berisi `ready for pickup` tanpa hard-code order number.
3. Gunakan role-based locator untuk kedua evidence.

en: The complete heading is stable, so treat the whole string as the contract.
The generated order number is variable; assert only the stable phrase in the status.
Use `toHaveText('Order confirmed')` for the heading and `toContainText('ready for pickup')` for the status.
id: Complete heading-nya stable, jadi perlakukan seluruh string sebagai contract.
Generated order number bisa berubah; assert hanya stable phrase di dalam status.
Gunakan `toHaveText('Order confirmed')` untuk heading dan `toContainText('ready for pickup')` untuk status.

challenges.htmlContent:
Order confirmed

Order 1042 is ready for pickup
challenges.solution:
await expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Order confirmed');
await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('ready for pickup');

The **Notification email** field starts with an old address. Replace it with `test@example.com`, then use `toHaveValue()` on the same labeled input. Input values are form state, not normal element text, so `toHaveText()` would express the wrong evidence type.

en: Locate the input from its `Notification email` label.
Use `fill()` to replace the old address rather than appending to it.
Assert the field's live form state with `toHaveValue('test@example.com')`.
id: Cari input dari label `Notification email`.
Gunakan `fill()` untuk mengganti address lama, bukan menambahkan text ke belakangnya.

description.en: Establish a disabled starting state, change consent, and prove submission becomes available.
description.id: Establish disabled starting state, ubah consent, lalu buktikan submission menjadi tersedia.

instructions.en:
# Prove a Control-State Transition

The registration rule keeps **Submit** disabled until **Accept Terms** is checked. Establish the disabled starting state first, use `check()` to create the required consent state, then prove both the checkbox and button states.

## Your Task
1. Locate **Accept Terms** by label and **Submit** by role.
2. Prove Submit starts disabled.
3. Check Accept Terms and prove it is checked.
4. Prove Submit becomes enabled.
instructions.id:
# Buktikan Control-State Transition

Registration rule membuat **Submit** disabled sampai **Accept Terms** checked. Establish disabled starting state lebih dulu, gunakan `check()` untuk membuat required consent state, lalu buktikan checkbox dan button state.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Cari **Accept Terms** berdasarkan label dan **Submit** berdasarkan role.
2. Buktikan Submit dimulai dalam disabled state.
3. Check Accept Terms lalu buktikan state-nya checked.
4. Buktikan Submit menjadi enabled.

en: Capture the same Submit locator before the action so you can prove its transition.
Establish the precondition with `toBeDisabled()` before checking the consent control.
After `check()`, prove both the consent state and its consequence for Submit.
id: Simpan locator Submit yang sama sebelum action supaya kamu bisa membuktikan transition-nya.
Establish precondition dengan `toBeDisabled()` sebelum check consent control.
Setelah `check()`, buktikan consent state dan konsekuensinya pada Submit.

challenges.htmlContent:
<form>

description.en: Use an attribute assertion when the destination itself is the product contract.
description.id: Gunakan attribute assertion saat destination itu sendiri menjadi product contract.

instructions.en:
# Verify a Required Link Destination

The account page must send users from **Privacy policy** to `/legal/privacy` and open the external policy surface in a new tab. Here `href` and `target` are deliberate navigation contracts, so attribute assertions are appropriate. For ordinary outcomes, prefer what users observe after interaction instead of inspecting attributes by default.

## Your Task
1. Locate **Privacy policy** by link role and accessible name.
2. Prove its `href` is `/legal/privacy`.
3. Prove its `target` is `_blank`.
instructions.id:
# Verifikasi Required Link Destination

Account page harus mengarahkan user dari **Privacy policy** ke `/legal/privacy` dan membuka external policy surface di tab baru. Di sini `href` dan `target` memang deliberate navigation contract, jadi attribute assertion tepat digunakan. Untuk ordinary outcome, pilih behavior yang diamati user daripada default meng-inspect attribute.

description.en: Use soft assertions for independent diagnostics without treating them as permission to continue a dependent workflow.
description.id: Gunakan soft assertion untuk independent diagnostic tanpa menganggapnya sebagai izin melanjutkan dependent workflow.

instructions.en:
# Collect Independent Diagnostic Failures

A profile-readiness summary reports three independent checks: **Name: Ready**, **Email: Ready**, and **Password: Ready**. The team wants one run to collect evidence from all three lines. Use `expect.soft()` because these diagnostics do not depend on one another.

A soft failure still fails the test. It only lets later checks run. Do not use it to continue a workflow that depends on an earlier requirement passing.

## Your Task
1. Locate each readiness line by its exact visible text.
2. Use `expect.soft(...).toBeVisible()` for all three independent diagnostics.
3. Do not add a dependent action after the soft checks.
instructions.id:
# Kumpulkan Independent Diagnostic Failure

Profile-readiness summary menampilkan tiga independent check: **Name: Ready**, **Email: Ready**, dan **Password: Ready**. Team ingin satu run mengumpulkan evidence dari ketiga baris. Gunakan `expect.soft()` karena diagnostic ini nggak bergantung satu sama lain.

Soft failure tetap membuat test gagal. Bedanya, check berikutnya masih dijalankan. Jangan pakai soft assertion untuk melanjutkan workflow yang bergantung pada requirement sebelumnya.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Cari setiap readiness line lewat exact visible text.
2. Gunakan `expect.soft(...).toBeVisible()` untuk ketiga independent diagnostic.
3. Jangan tambahkan dependent action setelah soft check.

en: Each readiness line can be evaluated without relying on either of the others.
Pass the locator to `expect.soft()` and then call the normal matcher.
Soft assertions collect more evidence, but Playwright still marks the test failed if any of them fail.
id: Setiap readiness line bisa dievaluasi tanpa bergantung pada dua line lainnya.
Berikan locator ke `expect.soft()`, lalu panggil matcher seperti biasa.
Soft assertion mengumpulkan lebih banyak evidence, tetapi test tetap ditandai gagal kalau salah satunya gagal.

description.en: Prove that invalid registration data blocks submission and valid data clears the guidance and enables it.
description.id: Buktikan invalid registration data memblokir submission, lalu valid data menghapus guidance dan mengaktifkannya.

instructions.en:
# Core Scenario: Registration Follows Validation State

This standalone registration form starts with an invalid email and an empty password. Its business rule is observable in two states: invalid data shows guidance and blocks registration; valid data clears the guidance and makes registration available.

Choose the smallest sufficient evidence for that transition. You do not need to verify every piece of markup on the page.

## Your Task
1. Locate the email guidance by `alert` role and **Register** by button role.
2. Prove the guidance is visible with the exact text `Invalid email format`.
3. Prove Register starts disabled.
4. Fill **Email** with `user@example.com` and **Password** with `password123` by label.
5. Prove the email guidance becomes hidden and Register becomes enabled.
instructions.id:
# Core Scenario: Registration Mengikuti Validation State

Standalone registration form ini dimulai dengan invalid email dan password kosong. Business rule-nya terlihat dalam dua state: invalid data menampilkan guidance dan memblokir registration; valid data menghapus guidance lalu membuat registration tersedia.

Pilih evidence paling kecil yang sudah cukup untuk membuktikan transition itu. Kamu nggak perlu memverifikasi setiap markup yang ada di page.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Cari email guidance berdasarkan role `alert` dan **Register** berdasarkan button role.
2. Buktikan guidance terlihat dengan exact text `Invalid email format`.
3. Buktikan Register dimulai dalam disabled state.
4. Isi **Email** dengan `user@example.com` dan **Password** dengan `password123` berdasarkan label.
5. Buktikan email guidance menjadi hidden dan Register menjadi enabled.

en: Treat the initial invalid state as a precondition you must prove before changing the form.
Reuse the alert and Register locators so the assertions clearly describe one state transition.
After filling both labeled fields, prove both effects of the rule: guidance disappears and submission becomes available.
id: Anggap initial invalid state sebagai precondition yang perlu kamu buktikan sebelum mengubah form.
Reuse locator untuk alert dan Register supaya assertion-nya jelas menceritakan satu state transition.
Setelah mengisi kedua labeled field, buktikan dua efek rule-nya: guidance hilang dan submission tersedia.

description.en: Use a semantic button click and prove each activation changed the visible counter.

instructions.en:
# Activate a Counter Deliberately

This standalone drill focuses on one contract: activate the button named **Increment** three times and prove the visible counter reaches `3`. A normal `click()` waits for the button to resolve uniquely and become actionable before each activation. It does not prove the counter changed, so finish with a web-first assertion.

## Your Task
1. Locate the **Increment** button by role and accessible name.
2. Click it exactly three times.
3. Locate the counter by its **Counter Value** label.
4. Verify its text becomes `3` with `toHaveText()`.
instructions.id:
# Aktifkan Counter dengan Sengaja

Latihan standalone ini fokus pada satu kontrak: aktifkan button **Increment** tiga kali lalu buktikan visible counter menjadi `3`. Normal `click()` menunggu button ditemukan secara unik dan actionable sebelum setiap aktivasi. Click belum membuktikan counter berubah, jadi tutup skenario dengan web-first assertion.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Cari button **Increment** berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
2. Click tepat tiga kali.
3. Cari counter berdasarkan label **Counter Value**.
4. Verifikasi text-nya menjadi `3` dengan `toHaveText()`.

en: Use `getByRole('button', { name: 'Increment' })` for the action target.
The counter has the accessible label `Counter Value`.
Perform three clicks, then use `toHaveText('3')` on the counter.

Counter punya accessible label `Counter Value`.
Lakukan tiga click, lalu pakai `toHaveText('3')` pada counter.

instructions.en:
# Fill Form Fields

Use `fill()` when the test needs to set a form control to a known value. It replaces the existing value and fires input events. Character-by-character typing is for behavior that specifically depends on individual key events, not the routine default. Locate fields by their labels so the test follows the same form contract as the user.

## Your Task
1. Fill the **Email** field with `'qa@test.com'`.
2. Fill the **Password** field with `'secret123'`.
3. Verify the email field has the value `'qa@test.com'` using a web-first value assertion.
instructions.id:
# Isi Field Formulir

Gunakan `fill()` saat test perlu mengatur form control ke known value. Method ini mengganti existing value dan memicu input event. Character-by-character typing dipakai hanya untuk behavior yang memang bergantung pada setiap keyboard event, bukan sebagai default. Cari field berdasarkan label supaya test mengikuti form contract yang sama dengan user.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Isi field **Email** dengan `'qa@test.com'`.
2. Isi field **Password** dengan `'secret123'`.
3. Verifikasi Email punya value `'qa@test.com'` dengan `toHaveValue()`.

en: Identify the standard way to enter text that also clears the existing input first.
Target the input fields using the text that matches their visual labels on the screen.
Use .fill() for 'qa@test.com' and 'secret123', then verify the email with 'toHaveValue'.
id: Identifikasi cara standar untuk memasukkan teks yang juga menghapus input yang ada terlebih dahulu.
Targetkan kolom input menggunakan teks yang sesuai dengan label visual mereka di layar.
Gunakan .fill() untuk 'qa@test.com' dan 'secret123', lalu verifikasi email dengan 'toHaveValue'.

## Tugas Kamu

instructions.en:
# Upload a Resume

Use `setInputFiles()` to set the **Upload Resume** file input without automating the operating-system picker. In a real Playwright project, a string such as `tests/fixtures/resume.pdf` is a filesystem path and that file must exist. An in-memory payload is another option when no fixture is needed.

This browser playground simulates `resume.pdf`, so no local fixture is required here. Set that filename, then prove the application status contains `resume.pdf`. The status—not the method returning—is the observable outcome.
instructions.id:
# Upload Resume

Gunakan `setInputFiles()` untuk mengatur file input **Upload Resume** tanpa mengotomasi operating-system picker. Di real Playwright project, string seperti `tests/fixtures/resume.pdf` adalah filesystem path dan file tersebut wajib ada. In-memory payload juga bisa dipakai saat fixture nggak dibutuhkan.

Browser playground ini mensimulasikan `resume.pdf`, jadi kamu nggak membutuhkan local fixture. Atur filename tersebut, lalu buktikan application status berisi `resume.pdf`. Status-nya—bukan sekadar method selesai—adalah observable outcome.

en: Think about how Playwright handles file selection without needing to open a file picker window.
Use the '.setInputFiles()' method and provide the exact filename requested in the task.
Call setInputFiles('resume.pdf') on the file input locator and verify the status text reflects this choice.
id: Pikirkan tentang bagaimana Playwright menangani pemilihan file tanpa perlu membuka jendela pemilih file.

Panggil setInputFiles('resume.pdf') pada locator input file dan verifikasi teks status mencerminkan pilihan ini.

# Core Scenario: Express Checkout State

The business requirement is: add Widget Pro, set quantity to `3`, keep **Express Shipping** enabled, and complete checkout. The checkbox deliberately starts selected. instructions.id:
# Core Scenario: Express Checkout State

Business requirement-nya adalah: tambahkan Widget Pro, atur quantity menjadi `3`, pastikan **Express Shipping** tetap aktif, lalu selesaikan checkout. Checkbox sengaja dimulai dalam checked state. Blind click justru akan mematikan required state, jadi gunakan `check()` untuk menjelaskan state, bukan toggle. Gunakan `fill()` untuk known quantity, normal button click untuk aktivasi, dan status assertion sebagai final evidence.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Click button **Add to Cart**.
2. Isi **Quantity** dengan `3`.
3. Pastikan **Express Shipping** checked tanpa blind toggle.
4. Click **Checkout**.
5. Verifikasi status berisi `3 items (Express)`.

en: Use button roles for activation and labels for the form controls.
The checkbox already starts checked; `check()` preserves the required state.
Assert the final status after Checkout rather than inspecting intermediate DOM implementation.
id: Gunakan button role untuk aktivasi dan label untuk form control.
Checkbox sudah dimulai dalam checked state; `check()` menjaga required state tetap benar.
Assert final status setelah Checkout, bukan intermediate DOM implementation.

# Your First Observable Test

Complete the existing test body. Locate the `Welcome, QA` heading by role and accessible name, then use a web-first visibility assertion. The goal is to connect `test`, `page`, a user-facing locator, and `expect` in one small scenario.
instructions.id:
# Test Teramati Pertamamu

Lengkapi test body yang tersedia. Temukan heading `Welcome, QA` berdasarkan role dan accessible name, lalu gunakan web-first visibility assertion. Tujuannya adalah menghubungkan `test`, `page`, locator yang menghadap pengguna, dan `expect` dalam satu skenario kecil.

en: Headings have the `heading` role.
Use `await expect(locator).toBeVisible()`.
id: Heading memiliki role `heading`.
Gunakan `await expect(locator).toBeVisible()`.

title.en: Wait for the Outcome, Not the Clock

description.en: Replace a fixed delay with an assertion that waits for the save result users can observe.
description.id: Ganti fixed delay dengan assertion yang menunggu hasil save yang dapat diamati pengguna.

instructions.en:
# Wait for the Outcome, Not the Clock

This standalone page changes its status from `Not saved` to `Saving…` and then asynchronously to `Profile saved`. A successful button click proves only that the action was possible. Prove the product outcome with a retried text assertion on the status region.

## Your Task
1. Click **Save profile** by role and accessible name.
2. Verify the status eventually has the exact text `Profile saved`.
3. Do not use `waitForTimeout()`; wait for the observable condition, not elapsed time.
instructions.id:
# Tunggu Outcome, Bukan Waktu

Standalone page ini mengubah status dari `Not saved` menjadi `Saving…`, lalu secara asynchronous menjadi `Profile saved`. Button click yang berhasil baru membuktikan action bisa dilakukan. Buktikan product outcome dengan retried text assertion pada status region.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Click **Save profile** berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
2. Verifikasi status akhirnya punya exact text `Profile saved`.
3. Jangan pakai `waitForTimeout()`; tunggu observable condition, bukan waktu yang berlalu.

en: Locate the status by role after clicking.
`toHaveText` retries until the asynchronous update appears.
id: Temukan status berdasarkan role setelah klik.
`toHaveText` melakukan retry sampai update asynchronous muncul.

challenges.htmlContent: Not saved
challenges.solution:
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save profile' }).click();
await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('Profile saved');

title.en: Core Investigation: Repair the Wrong-Order Test
title.id: Core Investigation: Perbaiki Test yang Salah Order

description.en: Use supplied failure evidence to remove an order-selection assumption, masking wait, and weak snapshot assertion.
description.id: Gunakan supplied failure evidence untuk menghapus order-selection assumption, masking wait, dan weak snapshot assertion.

instructions.en:
# Core Investigation: Repair the Wrong-Order Test

This standalone page lists two failed orders. The requirement is to resubmit **Order ORD-1042** and prove that same order reaches `Order submitted: ORD-1042`.

The generated starter test is unreliable and can produce a false positive. The supplied failure evidence says:

- the failed trace resolved `.first()` to **Order ORD-1007** because record order differed between runs;
- both cards contain a **Submit order** button and a status;
- `waitForTimeout(1000)` only delayed the weak check; and
- `textContent()` plus `toBeTruthy()` passed for any non-empty status, including the wrong order.

## Your Task
1. Locate the `article` for **Order ORD-1042** by filtering with its exact heading.
2. Prove exactly one target article matches.
3. Click **Submit order** inside that article.
4. Use a retried text assertion on the status inside the same article to prove the exact outcome `Order submitted: ORD-1042`.
5. Remove `first()`, `waitForTimeout()`, and `textContent()`. Do not suppress failures or weaken the expected result.
instructions.id:
# Core Investigation: Perbaiki Test yang Salah Order

Standalone page ini menampilkan dua failed order. Requirement-nya adalah resubmit **Order ORD-1042** lalu membuktikan order yang sama mencapai `Order submitted: ORD-1042`.

Generated starter test-nya unreliable dan bisa menghasilkan false positive. Supplied failure evidence mengatakan:

- failed trace menunjukkan `.first()` memilih **Order ORD-1007** karena urutan record berbeda antar-run;
- kedua card punya button **Submit order** dan status;
- `waitForTimeout(1000)` hanya menunda weak check; serta
- `textContent()` ditambah `toBeTruthy()` lulus untuk status apa pun yang nggak kosong, termasuk order yang salah.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Cari `article` milik **Order ORD-1042** dengan filter berdasarkan exact heading-nya.
2. Buktikan hanya ada satu target article yang match.
3. Click **Submit order** di dalam article tersebut.
4. Gunakan retried text assertion pada status di dalam article yang sama untuk membuktikan exact outcome `Order submitted: ORD-1042`.
5. Hapus `first()`, `waitForTimeout()`, dan `textContent()`. Jangan menyembunyikan failure atau melemahkan expected result.

en: Start from all `article` roles, then use `filter({ has: ... })` with the exact ORD-1042 heading.
Keep the button and status locators inside the filtered order so another card cannot satisfy the test.
Use `toHaveCount(1)` for target identity and exact `toHaveText()` for the business outcome.
id: Mulai dari semua role `article`, lalu pakai `filter({ has: ... })` dengan exact heading ORD-1042.
Pastikan button dan status locator tetap berada di dalam filtered order supaya card lain nggak bisa meluluskan test.
Gunakan `toHaveCount(1)` untuk target identity dan exact `toHaveText()` untuk business outcome.
